actions.description: Searches dictionary for word definitions and phonetics.
Adds a word to personal vocabulary deck for spaced repetition.
Applies SM-2 adaptive review rating (Forgot, Hard, Good, Easy).
Removes a word from the deck and records Landauer bit erasure.
Reversibly restores previous flashcard review rating or deck mutation.
Submits user friction, critique, or ergonomic feedback directly into the generational learning stream.
